name: OW6-R-band-ids-taken
note: A band's word read as a raider's.

name: OW6-R-life-too-many
old:
if (l !== life && l !== life - 1) return false;
  const reach = RAIDER_REACH_PX + RAIDER_CELL_PX;
new:
if (l !== life && l !== life - 1 && l !== life - 2) return false;
  const reach = RAIDER_REACH_PX + RAIDER_CELL_PX;
note: Words about raiders two lives gone kept.

name: OW6-R-reach-off
old:
const reach = RAIDER_REACH_PX + RAIDER_CELL_PX;
  return Math.abs(Number(m[1]) * RAIDER_CELL_PX - at.x) <= reach
new:
const reach = RAIDER_REACH_PX + 2 * RAIDER_CELL_PX;
  return Math.abs(Number(m[1]) * RAIDER_CELL_PX - at.x) <= reach
note: Words about raiders past my reach kept.

name: OW6-R-spent-unheard
note: A raider a peer fought stands again for me.

name: OW6-R-yield-lost
note: Two players chased by one sail.

name: OW6-R-peer-hold-lost
old: if (tvRaid.spent.has(r.id) || tvRaid.chase.has(r.id) || seaRaidPeerChase(r.id)) continue;   // OW6: never a sail a peer's chase holds
note: A sail a peer's chase holds gives chase to me too.

name: OW6-R-peer-place-unused
old: const at = ship ? state.worldCoords(ship.pos) : c ? c.pos : (seaRaidPeerChase(r.id) ?? r);   // OW6: one a peer's chase holds, where they say it sails
new: const at = ship ? state.worldCoords(ship.pos) : c ? c.pos : r;
note: A peer's chase drawn where the sail would wander, not where it runs.

name: OW6-R-spent-unsaid
old: tvRaid.chase.delete(id); seaRaidSpend(id);   // OW6: spent, and said to the others
note: A raider that came alongside is never said spent.

name: OW6-R-word-unwritten
note: The chase never rides the frame.

name: OW6-R-stale-kept
old: if (performance.now() - p.at > p.hold) { tvRaid.peer.delete(id); return null; }
note: A peer's word believed for ever: the sail never sails its own course again.
